questions.question: Which country hosted the G20 Summit in 2026?
questions.explanation: South Africa hosted the G20 Summit in 2026 under its presidency theme 'Solidarity, Equality, Sustainability', marking the first African nation to host the summit.

questions.question: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) recently revised the repo rate to:
questions.explanation: The RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) revised the repo rate to 5.75% in its June 2026 meeting to balance inflation and growth concerns.

questions.question: Which Indian city was recently declared as the 'Smart City of the Year 2026' by the Union Ministry of Housing?
questions.explanation: Surat, Gujarat was declared 'Smart City of the Year 2026' for its excellent implementation of smart infrastructure, waste management, and digital governance initiatives.

questions.question: The 'Mission Mausam' initiative launched by India is related to:
questions.explanation: Mission Mausam is India's ambitious program to revolutionize weather forecasting through advanced Doppler radars, high-performance computing systems, and AI-powered prediction models.

questions.question: Which organization recently released the 'Global Hunger Index 2026'?
questions.explanation: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), along with Welthungerhilfe and Concern Worldwide, released the Global Hunger Index 2026 to measure hunger across developing nations.

questions.question: India's first underwater metro tunnel was inaugurated in which city?
questions.explanation: Kolkata's underwater metro tunnel under the Hooghly River was the first of its kind in India, connecting Howrah to Esplanade and significantly reducing travel time.

questions.question: The 'One Nation One Ration Card' scheme aims to enable beneficiaries to:
options: Access PDS benefits anywhere in India
questions.correctAnswer: Access PDS benefits anywhere in India
questions.explanation: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) allows migrant workers and others to access their entitled food grains from any Fair Price Shop across India using a single ration card.

questions.question: Which planet in our solar system was recently found to have a new ring system by the James Webb Space Telescope?
questions.explanation: The James Webb Space Telescope provided unprecedented images of Uranus's ring system, revealing new details about the planet's 13 known rings and 27 moons.

questions.question: The 'PM Vishwakarma Yojana' primarily targets:
questions.explanation: PM Vishwakarma Yojana is a central government scheme to support traditional artisans and craftspeople (vishwakarmas) with financial assistance, skill training, and market linkages.

questions.question: Which Indian athlete won gold at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in athletics?
questions.explanation: Neeraj Chopra continued his golden run by winning gold in javelin throw at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, setting a new Games record in the process.

questions.question: The 'Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme' is implemented by which ministry?
questions.explanation: The Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (DILRMP) is under the Ministry of Rural Development, aiming to digitize land records to reduce disputes and improve transparency.

questions.question: Which country recently became the newest member of BRICS in 2026?
questions.explanation: Indonesia officially joined BRICS in 2026, becoming one of the largest economies to join the bloc, strengthening BRICS's representation in Southeast Asia.

questions.question: The 'Sagarmatha Sambad' dialogue forum is related to which country?
questions.explanation: Sagarmatha Sambad (Sagarmatha Dialogue) is an international dialogue platform hosted by Nepal on climate change, mountain ecosystems, and related global challenges, named after Mount Everest (Sagarmatha).

questions.question: India's GSAT-20 satellite primarily serves which sector?
questions.explanation: GSAT-20 (also called GSAT-N2) is a high-throughput communication satellite that provides broadband internet services, particularly for in-flight and maritime connectivity across India.

questions.question: The 'Aspirational Districts Programme' in India is monitored by:
questions.explanation: The Aspirational Districts Programme is monitored by NITI Aayog in close collaboration with state governments and line ministries to transform the most underdeveloped districts in India.
